test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 1st January 2017 was a Thursday, then what day of the week was it on 31st March of that year?
solution:
Given that:-

 
• No of days from 2 January 2017 to 31 March 2017 = 30 + 28 + 31 = 89 as 2017 is a non-leap year.
 
• Since, it was Thursday on 1 January 2017, every 7th day from 1 January will be a Thursday.
 
• Thus, no. of odd days = 89/7 = 5
 
• Now, 1 January 2017 (Thursday) + 5 odd days = 31 March 2017 (Tuesday)
 
• 31st March 2017 will be Tuesday.

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
